editorNote: October is stacked: a beloved palace mystery returns, two game-world fantasies start, and Netflix keeps the JoJo race running every Friday, with a fake-dating romcom and an alchemy tale teased for later.

stories.headline: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 starts October 2, with Yorushika and Eve on the themes
stories.summary: Season 3 premieres October 2 at 11 p.m. JST in the Friday Anime Night block, with Yorushika performing the opening and Eve performing the ending "AIYOU" per the second trailer. The first cour runs this fall and the second arrives in April 2027.
stories.whyItMatters: A returning favorite with a split-cour run lets you settle in for two seasons' worth of mystery—pick it if you like your fantasy with a detective streak.

stories.headline: Steel Ball Run's 2nd and 3rd STAGE land on Netflix, with a new episode every Friday
stories.summary: Netflix began streaming the 2nd and 3rd STAGE of STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure on September 25 — 11 episodes, one per week on Fridays. The stages cross the Arizona desert and the Rocky Mountains as Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli press on through a deadly cross-country race.
stories.whyItMatters: It's the weekly appointment-viewing pick this month for anyone who wants something with tension and a road-trip structure.

stories.headline: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers premieres October 11
stories.summary: A class is swept into another world by a bus crash and blessed with strong stats, but hardcore RPG fan Makoto Takatsuki ends up with weak skills as an apprentice mage. He meets a minor goddess, Noah, who asks him to be her first believer. Toshinori Fukushima directs at HORNETS.
stories.whyItMatters: It fits the isekai-and-fantasy reader who likes underdog heroes and game-logic worlds.

stories.headline: Overgeared puts Grid in the spotlight ahead of its October 2 broadcast
stories.summary: In the virtual-reality game Satisfy, Youngwoo Shin — Grid — discovers a tome holding a legendary blacksmith's lost knowledge. The anime streams early on Prime Video in Japan from September 27, airs on TV from October 2, and Crunchyroll will carry it worldwide. Ayaka Kono directs at J.C.STAFF.
stories.whyItMatters: A good match for fantasy readers who enjoy game-world crafting and progression stories.

stories.headline: The Fake Alchemist reveals its teaser, leads and staff
stories.summary: The first teaser introduces the encounter between Paracelsus (Yōhei Matsuoka) and Nora (Miyari Nemoto) in the city-state of Orichalconia, where alchemy and magic are part of daily life. Passione animates, with Takeo Takahashi as chief director and Hijiri Sanpei directing.
stories.whyItMatters: It's one to put on the radar for the fantasy-reader who likes a new-world setting; no release date appears in the sources I read.

stories.headline: Now That We Draw sets a January 2027 premiere in its first trailer
stories.summary: The romcom follows Yuuki and Niina, two aspiring manga creators who enter a secret fake relationship to gain romantic experience for their work. Shunsuke Ishikawa directs at ROLL2, with Ayumu Murase and Sayumi Suzushiro voicing the leads; the manga runs in Hakusensha's Young Animal.
stories.whyItMatters: A light, creator-themed pick for the cozy-and-wholesome reader to mark on the calendar for winter.
